description: I'm a curious technology enthusiast passionate about space exploration, science, and innovation. I enjoy solving problems, exploring new ideas, and building impactful solutions. I'm looking for motivated teammates skilled in programming, AI/ML, web development, data science, astronomy, or UI/UX design. Most importantly, I value creativity, teamwork, and a willingness to learn. Let's combine our skills, think beyond boundaries, and build something extraordinary for the future of space exploration
